B.title: System Usability Scale (SUS)
B.intro: Please rate how easy GlucoCompanion was to use.

C.title: App consolidation
C.intro: Many people with diabetes use several apps in parallel — sensor app, logbook, insulin tracker, nutrition app. How do you rate GlucoCompanion in this context?

D.title: Gluco
D.intro: Gluco is an AI-supported chatbot you can talk to about daily life with diabetes. Please rate the following statements.

E.title: Mood & insights
E.intro: GlucoCompanion links your glucose readings with mood entries and provides insights. You can also enter free text that the AI converts into structured data.

F.title: Trust & privacy
F.intro: A few final questions about trust and data protection.

G.title: Open questions
G.intro: Finally, we would like to hear your own words.

H.title: Open questions
H.intro: Finally, we would like to hear your own words. Your answers help us most to improve the app.

items.a2: What type of diabetes do you have?
items.a3: How many years have you had diabetes?
items.a4: What is your main form of therapy?
items.a5: How many digital diabetes tools (apps, sensor apps, logbooks) do you use regularly?
items.a6: How often do you use AI chatbots (e.g. ChatGPT) in general?
items.a7: Have you ever used AI in connection with your diabetes?

items.pu3: C3. With GlucoCompanion I could handle diabetes-related tasks more efficiently.
items.pu4: C4. Overall I consider GlucoCompanion useful.

items.d1: D1. Gluco responded empathetically to my concerns in the test.

items.e4: E4. I can imagine that such a view with my own data would show me new connections.
items.e5: E5. An app that bundles several diabetes functions would noticeably simplify my day.
items.e6: E6. GlucoCompanion could replace or complement several tools I currently use.

items.f3: F3. The information on privacy and AI is written in an understandable way.
